limits: The writer is tested over synthetic held-out summaries; the committed T010 pair is checked by bytes, formats, arms and H1 against evidence/heldout-arms.json, and records H1 not supported. BL.2 never calls decide(). The SPEC-049 noninferiority test is not part of the frozen protocol and is reported descriptive-only, so an approved SPEC-073 promotion over this pair is refused (regression-not-covered) unless SPEC-073 decides otherwise.
outcome: passed: From synthetic held-out results, spec049_pair writes a SPEC-049 Registration and EvaluationRecord in REGISTRATION_FORMAT and REPORT_FORMAT with arm A = A0 and arm C = A2 (GEPA) by candidate hash, the H1 outcome per required host (claude-code) under the protocol rule (supported, not-supported, not-assessable; a canary hit invalidates the arm) and executionAuthorization false; both records load through the harness_promotion verifiers and a pending decide() call in the test accepts the pair with the C-vs-A regression descriptive-only. The writer never names decide, begin or harness_promotion. Negative controls: arm C set to A1 is refused (arm-c-not-a2), arm A not A0 is refused (arm-a-not-a0), a report edited after recording fails the byte check, and a report bound to another registration is refused (registration-mismatch). The committed T010 pair (evidence/heldout-registration.json, evidence/heldout-evaluation-record.json) matches the sha256 recorded in evidence/heldout-arms.json, loads through the harness_promotion verifiers, binds A = A0 and C = A2 by candidate hash, and records H1 not-supported for claude-code, equal to the held-out analysis.
